criteria_verification.notes: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements the 3-member IdentityProvider port with sync currentPrincipal backed by _currentPrincipal field. Implementation file confirmed in evidence.
Silent refresh attempted via _silentRefresh() using stored refresh token before falling back to interactive flow via _interactiveSignIn(). PKCE S256 is flutter_appauth default.
Interactive flow uses KeycloakConfig.redirectUrl, requests offline_access via _config.scopes, and completes on custom-scheme redirect. Configuration enforcement confirmed.
SignInCancelled and SignInFailed are distinct exception types. _isCancelError() distinguishes CANCELED code from other failures. No conflation.
Single-flight guard implemented via _signInInFlight field. Second signIn() returns existing Future instead of starting new flow.
Proactive refresh scheduled 5 minutes before expiry via _scheduleProactiveRefresh() using accessTokenExpirationDateTime. Background refresh executed via _performBackgroundRefresh().
Generation-based epoch (_generation counter) ensures signOut() wins over in-flight refresh. Refresh operations check generation before updating principal and discard stale updates.
Background refresh wrapped in try-catch, clears _currentPrincipal on failure. No exception propagation to sync currentPrincipal getter. Graceful degradation confirmed.
_performSignIn() checks storedSession for null and expiry via _isExpired(). Absent/unreadable/expired sessions skip silent refresh and trigger interactive flow. No initialization at launch.
FakeAppAuth and FakeSecureSessionStore implement required interfaces. Tests inject fakes via constructor. No browser, network, or platform channels in tests. Hermetic confirmed.
